info.title: Distru Public API - Manufacturing
info.description: Phase 0.5 audited 2026-05-21. See categories/manufacturing.md for full field grids.

get.description: List assemblies. Page size 5,000. READ-ONLY (no POST). SLOW — ~26s typical response time. Eventually consistent ~1s lag.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Single value, not bracket array (Active|Completed|Canceled etc)

parameters.name: creation_source
parameters.description: Phase 0.5 correction: SCALAR string (MANUAL|ORDER etc), NOT enum array. Single-value match.

200.description: Paginated assemblies. NO updated_datetime field on response (Phase 0.5 finding) — use inserted_datetime for ordering or refetch by id.
Single assembly with nested outputs[], ingredients[], additional_costs[]. NO labor[] or machine_info — labor/machine both live in additional_costs[] discriminated by type field.
